class.name: NNBlackboardSchema
class.brief_description: Defines allowed key types and default values for an [NNBlackboard].
class.description:
Assign an [NNBlackboardSchema] to [member NNBlackboard.schema] when you want to enforce expected key types, reject unknown keys, or automatically populate default values for a blackboard. [codeblock] var health := NNBlackboardKey.new() health.key = "health" health.value_type = TYPE_INT health.has_default = true health.default_value = 100
var schema := NNBlackboardSchema.new() schema.allow_unknown_keys = false schema.keys.append(health) board.schema = schema [/codeblock]

method.name: accepts
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if writing [param value] to [param key] is permitted by this schema. [code]null[/code] is always allowed.

method.name: get_defaults
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] of default values for every key with [member NNBlackboardKey.has_default] enabled.

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns a list of configuration errors in [member keys], or an empty array if the schema is valid.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], keys not listed in [member keys] accept any value. If [code]false[/code], writes to undeclared keys are rejected.
Declared [NNBlackboardKey] entries defining allowed types and optional defaults.
